assign.card: core/Page: Page vs Item, page CRUD audit, what pages must carry later (analysis seat d)

now: reading core/Page and core/Item to compare their APIs

outcome: Page vs Item measured and page CRUD run: a session should HAVE a page (TaskPage and AISessionDetail already do this; Session > Task and Page > Item cannot merge without surgery, and children/content/render collide). Subpages add/rename/remove works (33 + 21 checks, scratch tree, headless), but a created child is invisible from a page.js parent, and nothing does a move between parents or a redirect after rename. Child pages are fed four ways into one List behind a still-live Map shim. Proposed: one `pages` List with one ref shape shared with tasks. ext/editor is a working snapshot-mode layer editor.
